# developer.paypal.com documentation — Api — Webhooks

> 19 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Api under Webhooks. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Webhooks

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/): API Reference Overview
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/definitions/webhooks_lookup_list): An array of webhook lookups.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/overview/): Webhooks are HTTPS posts from PayPal to an endpoint on your server whenever the corresponding event type occurs.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-events-list): Lists webhooks event notifications. Use query parameters to filter the response.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/verify-webhook-signature-post): Verifies a webhook signature.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-list): Lists webhooks for an app.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-post): Subscribes your webhook listener to events.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-get): Shows details for a webhook, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-update): Updates a webhook to replace webhook fields with new values. Supports only the `replace` operation.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-delete): Deletes a webhook, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/event-types-list): Lists event subscriptions for a webhook, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-lookup-list): Lists webhook lookups.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-lookup-post): Creates a webhook lookup. A webhook lookup ties the API caller's REST API app to the subject account (or, if no subject is specified, to the API caller's account).
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-lookup-get): Shows details for a webhook lookup, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-lookup-delete): Deletes a webhook lookup, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-event-types-list): Lists available events to which any webhook can subscribe. For a list of supported events, see [Webhook event names](/docs/api/notifications/webhooks/event-names/).
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-events-get): Shows details for a webhooks event notification, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/webhooks-events-resend): Resends a webhook event notification, by ID. Any pending notifications are not resent.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/webhooks/v1/simulate-event-post): Simulates a webhook event. In the JSON request body, specify a sample payload.
